Nora (Marketing): Quick brainstorm 15m sync: micro-launch + 'nudge' sequence. Goal: 80 activations from console triers. Thoughts?
Ethan (Growth): Keep it tiny: 20m live demo, 3 prompt templates, 50 starter credits. Two arms: full upfront vs gated unlock.
Pri (Product): We'll surface templates in-console during demo and show per-prompt token & latency estimates. That benchmark helps reduce surprise.
Jules (Onboarding): Suggested gating: 20 credits at signup, 30 after completing checklist step 1 (create key), 0/bonus 30 after saving a prompt. Reduces abuse.
Sam (Ops): Routing: demo -> pool "nudge-demo-v1"; fallback hosted. Add per-user promo cap 100 and expiry 30 days.
Nora (Marketing): Landing copy idea: "Ship a live LLM flow in 20 minutes 10m demo + 10m quick-start + credits" CTA: "Claim spot & credits". Keep it short.
Ethan (Growth): Metrics: landing CVR, attendance rate, first-run (first 10 tokens), day7 active calls, credit consumption. We'll run A/B on credit split.
Pri (Product): Prompt packs: "Release note writer", "Support reply", "SQL explain". Each with a run button and token estimate. We'll instrument avg tokens for post-webinar benchmark email.
Jules (Onboarding): Checklist draft: 1) create API key, 2) run a template, 3) save template to library. Unlock flows tied to flags. I'll draft copy by EOD.
Sam (Ops): I'll deliver route policy and guard rails. Event create: EventBot: "Micro Launch: nudge + credits" 2026-04-14 17:00 UTC.
Nora (Marketing): Action items: Nora = landing + promo, Ethan = experiment wiring, Pri = prompt packs + modal, Jules = checklist + gating copy, Sam = route + caps. Reconvene after landing draft. :rocket:
